entries.title: Upcoming changes to the Free version of Flowtime
entries.subtitle: Important announcement for Flowtime users.

slides.label: ANNOUNCEMENT
slides.title: Upcoming changes to the Free version of Flowtime
slides.description:
Hi everyone,

I wanted to give you a heads-up about an upcoming change to Flowtime's Free plan.

Starting August 16th, Flowtime will adopt a new Free vs Pro feature structure.

slides.label: NEW
slides.title: Free features
items: Standard Timer
Standard notifications
Pomodoro (fixed intervals)
1 Project
1 day of History

slides.label: NEW
slides.title: Pro features
slides.description: The following features will become Flowtime Pro:
items: Flow Sessions
Flowmodoro
Custom Pomodoro intervals
Unlimited Projects
Unlimited History
App Blocking
Quick Start Templates
Reminder Profiles
UI customization (accent colors)
Reports & Exports

slides.label: NEW
slides.title: Why the change?
slides.description:
Flowtime has grown a lot since its first release.
New features continue to be added, and maintaining the app takes time and ongoing costs.

My goal has always been to keep Flowtime privacy-first, account-free, and free from ads. Introducing a clearer distinction between Free and Pro helps make continued development sustainable while still offering a fully usable free version for anyone who just needs a simple focus timer.

slides.label: NEW
slides.title: Existing users
slides.description:
These changes will take effect on August 16th. Until then, everything will continue to work as it does today.
As a thank you to everyone who supported Flowtime during its first months, Lifetime Pro will be available at 50% off until August 31st. If you've been using Flowtime before these changes, this is my way of saying thank you for helping shape the app.

items: Improved Free vs Pro experience and updated upgrade screens
New release notes and in-app update notifications
Better accent color handling and improved theme behavior

slides.label: PRIVACY
slides.title: Anonymous Usage Analytics
slides.description: Flowtime uses TelemetryDeck to collect anonymous usage statistics. These analytics help improve the app by identifying crashes, feature usage, and performance issues. No advertising identifiers are collected, no user profiles are created, and the collected information is not used for advertising or cross-app tracking.

slides.description: Quick Start templates, notification templates, and 10 language support.
items: Quick Start templates and notification templates
10 language support and general stability fixes
